reasoning: The icon shows a five-pointed star surrounded by four shining rays. While stars are often used as generic priority toggles in UI chrome, a glowing star also represents real task subjects like customer ratings/reviews, awards and achievements, loyalty points, star decorations, and stargazing. It only loses some distinctiveness because many icon sets have several plain and sparkling star variants.
